lede: The biggest thing to track this week is Telluride Town Council's Tuesday meeting, where a public hearing is scheduled on extending a vesting period for an existing project — the kind of land-use decision that tends to matter more than it sounds. Ouray is also deep in consequential territory, with a joint city-county session Monday on a proposed intergovernmental agreement that would hand full law enforcement for the City of Ouray to the County Sheriff starting January 2027. Meanwhile, San Miguel County's BOCC and Planning Commission both have affordable housing items up — including a public hearing on waiving fees for Mountain Village's Ilium Valley project — and the county's Planning Commission is in a joint work session on an affordable housing code update Thursday.
